ceo.notes: Identity is well confirmed by full name, company, CEO role, 2024 local annual report, official Europlan FY2024 news and 2022 appointment-chain sources. Education is supported by an accessible Kommersant biography; searches for primary e-disclosure/Rusbonds PDFs and university alumni confirmation were attempted, but the PDFs timed out and no accessible university page was found. No confirmed academic degree, research profile, publications, patents or h-index were found. Similar-name scientific profiles and unrelated Sergey results were rejected. Post-2024 sources indicate a later 2026 transition to Alfa-Bank and a new Europlan CEO; this was not used to alter the 2024 role. ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, targeted gap-fill + GICS/qualification_degree/university-name normalization pass, per REFINEMENT.md): (1) Local LEAS files re-checked programmatically (full-text scan of all 88 annual-report pages for keywords Mizyur, obrazovan, Pyatigorsk, MIRBIS) -- no new biography pages found beyond round 1 (pp. 7, 55, 56-58, 67, 88); pages 17, 42-43, 66-67, 80 additionally checked -- industry/risk context and executive-bodies section, no new education facts. (2) Targeted web research on remaining gaps: the year of the Project Management course at American Institute of Business and Economics was searched again (WebFetch on Kommersant doc/7656655 and on a VK post via DuckDuckGo HTML) -- no year is given in either source, so education[2].year stays null. Repeat attempts to open an e-disclosure PDF (FileLoad.ashx?Fileid=1768068 -- opened, but it is a 6m2022 report with no director biography) and a Rusbonds PDF (Alfa_Equity_Eng_2024_06_06.pdf -- returned empty) produced no official biography with education data; sfiholding.ru returned a TLS certificate error. A repeat targeted fetch of Kommersant doc/5411732 confirmed the same career chronology (2005 sales -> 2014 Management Board/VP/deputy CEO -> Nov 2016-June 2022 VP -> June 2022 General Director) without giving a more precise end date for the "sales specialist/manager" role before 2014 -- professional_experience[0].end_year is deliberately left null (rule: prefer null over an unverified guess). (3) qualification_degree assigned to all 3 education[] entries: PGLU (2004, specialty perevod i perevodovedenie, qualification perevodchik nemetskogo i angliyskogo yazykov) = Specialist degree -- perevod i perevodovedenie was a standard 5-year specialist-track program in the Russian education system before the wide Bologna-system transition (2003-2011), completed in 2004, and the qualification title perevodchik (translator) is the classic label for a specialist-era program, not a bachelor's/master's one (methodology aligned with round 2 of GAZP/DVEC); MIRBIS (2008, Strategicheskiy menedzhment i predprinimatelstvo) = MBA -- the source states the qualification verbatim as MBA; American Institute of Business and Economics (Project Management course, year not found) = Executive education -- a short targeted course at a business school, not a degree program (methodology aligned with similar "executive courses" entries in AQUA/HNFG). (4) Institution names normalized to university_names.json: "Moskovskaya mezhdunarodnaya vysshaya shkola biznesa MIRBIS" -> "Moskovskaya mezhdunarodnaya vysshaya shkola biznesa «MIRBIS»" (canonical key with guillemets); "American Institute of Business and Economics, Moscow" -> "American Institute of Business and Economics" (canonical key, city suffix dropped); PGLU already matched the canonical form, unchanged. No new institutions found for new_institutions_found -- all three institutions were already present in university_names.json. (5) GICS: the company and all 3 professional_experience entries (all refer to Europlan itself under different legal-name phrasings and in different roles) are classified as Financials / Financial Services (New Name) / Consumer Finance -- the Consumer Finance sub-industry definition in 2025-gics-structure-english.xlsx explicitly includes "lease financing", which precisely describes Europlan's core business (vehicle and special-equipment leasing). (6) tmt[] stays empty: the LEAS CSV row (row 303) was re-checked -- only one entry (Mizyura, General Director), no other individuals listed for LEAS in MOEXBMI_2024.csv. All other round-1 facts (identity, 2024 CEO role, career chronology, all sources) were not revisited or removed.

validation_notes:
Processed 1 CSV person for LEAS. Checked 5 local PDF documents plus the CSV row before web research: the 2024 annual report, IFRS statements, annual-report appendices 1, 2 and 5. Completed 1 research round; no additional round was required because the only remaining gaps were narrow and repeated search passes produced no higher-quality accessible source. Identity and 2024 CEO role are strongly confirmed by local and official sources. Education is confirmed by an accessible Kommersant biography, while primary e-disclosure/Rusbonds PDF attempts timed out and university confirmation was not found. Board and Management Board names for 2024 remain intentionally undisclosed in the local annual report under Government Resolution No. 1102; no people absent from the CSV were added. Weak/auxiliary sources used only for corroboration or disambiguation: Cbonds, MarketScreener, Reputation.ru and OpenSanctions. Excluded namesakes included unrelated Sergey Brin, Sergey Mirov, Sergey Y. Misyura scholarly profiles and generic patent/inventor results. No confirmed academic degree, research experience, publications, patents or h-index were found. Post-2024 2026 sources indicating Mizyura's transition to Alfa-Bank were not used to change the 2024 role.

ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, targeted gap-fill + GICS/qualification_degree/university-name normalization pass, per REFINEMENT.md): Processed 1 person (CEO Mizyura S.N.); tmt[] is empty and stays empty -- the LEAS CSV row (row 303) was re-checked and contains no other individuals. Added: (1) sector/industry_group/industry at company level -- Financials / Financial Services (New Name) / Consumer Finance; source -- the GICS Consumer Finance sub-industry definition in 2025-gics-structure-english.xlsx ("providers of consumer finance services, including personal credit, credit cards, lease financing..."), which precisely covers Europlan's leasing business; reliability high. (2) The same three fields added to all 3 professional_experience entries (all refer to Europlan itself) -- same justification. (3) qualification_degree added to all 3 education[] entries: Specialist degree for PGLU 2004 (specialist-track perevod i perevodovedenie program before the Bologna-system transition, qualification perevodchik typical for that era -- inferred from context, reasoning also recorded in ceo.notes); MBA for MIRBIS 2008 (the source states the qualification verbatim as MBA -- not an inference, a direct match); Executive education for the Project Management course at American Institute of Business and Economics (a short targeted course, not a degree program -- methodology aligned with similar entries in other tickers of this project, e.g. AQUA/HNFG). degrees[] has no entries -- field stayed empty, no change needed. (4) Institution names normalized to university_names.json: MIRBIS -> "Moskovskaya mezhdunarodnaya vysshaya shkola biznesa «MIRBIS»" (canonical key); American Institute of Business and Economics -> canonical key without the ", Moscow" suffix; PGLU already matched the canonical name. new_institutions_found added as an empty list -- both institutions were already present in university_names.json, no new institutions found. (5) A targeted gap-fill round was run on every field previously flagged as null/uncertain in the round-1 notes: the year of the Project Management course (re-searched -- Kommersant doc/7656655 via WebFetch, DuckDuckGo HTML/lite search on VK and other sources -- year still not stated, stays null); the exact end date of the "sales specialist/manager" role before joining the Management Board in 2014 (re-checked Kommersant doc/5411732 -- the transition date is not detailed beyond "since 2014", this entry's end_year stays null); attempts to open e-disclosure (FileLoad.ashx?Fileid=1768068 -- opened, but is a 6m2022 report with no director biography) and Rusbonds (Alfa_Equity_Eng_2024_06_06.pdf -- empty response) PDFs were repeated via WebFetch and produced no new biographical information; sfiholding.ru is unreachable due to a TLS certificate error. All local LEAS files were re-checked with a full-text keyword scan -- no new CEO-biography pages found beyond those already used in round 1. (6) Round-2 self-check: all qualification_degree values (Specialist degree, MBA, Executive education) are within the allowed list of 10 strings; the sector/industry_group/industry triple (Financials / Financial Services (New Name) / Consumer Finance) at company level and in every professional_experience entry is an exact match to a row in gics_taxonomy.json; both normalized institution values match keys in university_names.json; no previously confirmed round-1 field was deleted or overwritten.
